    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "(Par)boil the {{ing_01|truffles}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Sprinkle with {{ing_02|salt}} and fasten them on skewers."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Half fry them and then place them in a sauce pan with {{ing_03|broth}}, {{ing_04|virgin oil}}, {{ing_05|reduced wine}}, {{ing_06|a little pure wine}}, {{ing_07|crushed pepper}} and {{ing_08|a little honey}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Allow them to finish (gently and well covered)."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "When done, bind the liquor with {{ing_09|roux}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Prick the {{ing_01|truffles}} so they may become saturated with the juice."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Dress them nicely, and when real hot, serve."
